description: Angular component for managing entity relations via a dialog interface, including form handling, validation, and service interactions.

classes.name: RelationDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for relation dialog, handling form creation, validation, and saving entity relations.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form and component state, setting entity types based on user authority.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a form control is in an error state for UI validation feedback.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without saving changes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates form data and saves the relation, either creating new relations or updating existing ones.
